# Electrofruit

**Electrofruit** is a solid (drilled tile by tile) ore. Each extraction yields **300** units, and the zone holds it in finite **deposits (nodes)** — when a node is mined below its threshold it is removed and the zone regenerates nodes up to its configured maximum. How the node-generation columns below are used by the server is in [Ore fields](/zh-TW/formats/ore-fields/).

## 開採

| Property | 數值 |
|---|---|
| 單次開採量 | 300 |
| 開採方式 | solid (drilled tile by tile) |
| 觸發效果 | 不需要 |


This ore has no zone node configuration — it is not regenerated in any zone (it exists as a material for production and missions).
